hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */package-lock.json|package-lock.json|*/Cargo.lock|Cargo.lock) echo "Refusing to hand-edit generated lock file: $f (regenerate via 'npm install' or 'cargo build')." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; exit 0
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.rs) command -v rustfmt >/dev/null 2>&1 && rustfmt --edition 2021 "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0
